notes.title: Update Notes for June 25
notes.content:
A Touch Maze update has been released today.  All updates are a result of feedback from players. 

Here is a list of what is in the update:

[list]
[*]Fixed Double Click Issue Reported by Players
[*]Fixed issue with obstacles being hidden near the finish line.
[*]Updated the menu button text and level update text to be more clear.
[*]Added instructions to level 1 based on player feedback.
[*]Hide the Start of level message as soon as the player starts the level.
[/list]
